sentences.en: Architecture is the art and science of designing buildings and structures.
sentences.zh: 建筑是设计建筑和结构的艺术和科学。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: A building reflects the scientific and technological achievements of the age as well as the ideas and aspirations of the designer and client.
sentences.zh: 一座建筑反映了时代的科学和技术成就以及设计者和客户的想法和愿望。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: The appearance of individual buildings, however, is often controversial.
sentences.zh: 然而,个别建筑物的外观往往引起争议。

sentences.en: The use of an architectural style cannot be said to start or finish on a specific date.
sentences.zh: 无法说在特定日期开始或完成使用建筑风格。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Neither is it possible to say exactly what characterises a particular movement.
sentences.zh: 也不能确切地说某一运动的特征是什么。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: But the origins of what is now generally known as modern architecture can be traced back to the social and technological changes of the 18th and 19th centuries.
sentences.zh: 但是,现在被普遍称为现代建筑的起源可以追溯到18世纪和19世纪的社会和技术变革。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Instead of using timber, stone and traditional building techniques, architects began to explore ways of creating buildings by using the latest technology and materials such as steel, glass and concrete strengthened steel bars, known as reinforced concrete.
sentences.zh: 建筑师不使用木材、石块和传统建筑技术,而是开始探索建筑建造方法,使用最新的技术和材料,如钢、玻璃和混凝土加固钢铁,称为加固混凝土。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Technological advances also helped bring about the decline of rural industries and an increase in urban populations as people moved to the towns to work in the new factories.
sentences.zh: 技术进步还有助于导致农村工业的衰退,以及随着人们迁往城镇在新工厂工作而增加城市人口。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Such rapid and uncontrolled growth helped to turn parts of cities into slums.
sentences.zh: 这种迅速和无控制的增长有助于将城市部分地区变成贫民窟。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: By the 1920s architects throughout Europe were reacting against the conditions created by industrialisation.
sentences.zh: 1920年代,全欧洲的建筑师们都对工业化创造的条件做出反应。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: A new style of architecture emerged to reflect more idealistic notions for the future.
sentences.zh: 出现了一种新的结构风格,以反映未来更理想主义的概念。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: It was made possible by new materials and construction techniques and was known as Modernism.
sentences.zh: 新的材料和建筑技术使这一计划成为可能,并被称为现代主义。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: By the 1930s many buildings emerging from this movement were designed in the International Style.
sentences.zh: 到1930年代,从这一运动中产生的许多建筑物都是以国际风格设计的。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: This was largely characterised by the bold use of new materials and simple, geometric forms, often with white walls supported by stilt¬like pillars.
sentences.zh: 其特征主要是大胆地使用新材料和简单的几何形式,往往用白色墙壁支持的像石柱一样的柱子。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: These were stripped of unnecessary decoration that would detract from their primary purpose — to be used or lived in.
sentences.zh: 这些装置被剥去不必要的装饰,从而偏离了它们的首要目的——即使用或居住。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Walter Gropius, Charles Jeanneret (better known as Le Corbusier) and Ludwig Mies van der Rohe were among the most influential of the many architects who contributed to the development of Modernism in the first half of the century.
sentences.zh: 沃尔特·格罗皮乌斯、查尔斯·琼内雷特(更名勒科布西耶)和路德维希·米斯·范德罗赫是本世纪上半叶为现代主义发展作出贡献的许多建筑师中最具影响力的。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: But the economic depression of the 1930s and the second world war (1939-45) prevented their ideas from being widely realised until the economic conditions improved and war-torn cities had to be rebuilt.
sentences.zh: 但是,1930年代的经济萧条和第二次世界大战(1939-45年)使他们的思想无法被广泛实现,直到经济状况得到改善,饱受战争蹂躏的城市必须重建。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: By the 1950s, the International Style had developed into a universal approach to building, which standardised the appearance of new buildings in cities across the world.
sentences.zh: 到1950年代,国际风格发展成为一种普遍的建筑方法,使全世界城市中新建筑的外观标准化。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, this Modernist interest in geometric simplicity and function became exploited for profit.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是,现代主义者对几何简单和功能的这种兴趣被利用来牟利。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: The rediscovery of quick-and-easy-to-handle reinforced concrete and an improved ability to prefabricate building sections meant that builders could meet the budgets of commissioning authorities and handle a renewed demand for development quickly and cheaply.
sentences.zh: 重新发现快速和容易处理的强化混凝土,并增强预先制造建筑部分的能力,这意味着建筑商可以满足委托当局的预算,迅速和廉价地处理新的发展需求。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: But this led to many badly designed buildings, which discredited the original aims of Modernism.
sentences.zh: 但这导致许多设计不当的建筑,

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Influenced by Le Corbusier’s ideas on town planning, every large British city built multi-storey housing estates in the 1960s.
sentences.zh: 英国各大城市在1960年代都建起了多层房屋。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Massproduced, low-cost high-rises seemed to offer a solution to the problem of housing a growing inner-city population.
sentences.zh: 大规模生产、低成本高楼似乎为解决城市内人口不断增加的问题提供了解决办法。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: But far from meeting human needs, the new estates often proved to be windswept deserts lacking essential social facilities and services.
sentences.zh: 但是,新庄园远远没有满足人类的需要,往往证明是风吹风的沙漠,缺乏必要的社会设施和服务。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Many of these buildings were poorly designed and constructed and have since been demolished.
sentences.zh: 许多这些建筑物的设计和建造很差,后来被拆毁。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: By the 1970s, a new respect for the place of buildings within the existing townscape arose.
sentences.zh: 到1970年代,在现有城镇景象中建筑的位置出现了一种新的尊重。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Preserving historic buildings or keeping only their facades (or fronts) grew common.
sentences.zh: 保留历史建筑或只保留其外墙(或前方)的现象日益普遍。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: Architects also began to make more use of building styles and materials that were traditional to the area.
sentences.zh: 建筑师还开始更多地利用该地区传统的建筑风格和材料。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The architectural style usually referred to as High Tech was also emerging.
sentences.zh: 通常称为高科技的建筑风格也正在出现。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: It celebrated scientific and engineering achievements by openly parading the sophisticated techniques used in construction.
sentences.zh: 它通过公开展示建筑中使用的尖端技术来庆祝科学和工程成就。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Such buildings are commonly made of metal and glass; examples are Stansted airport and the Lloyd’s building in London.
sentences.zh: 这些建筑物通常由金属和玻璃组成;例如斯坦斯特德机场和伦敦劳埃德大楼。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: Disillusionment at the failure of many of the poor imitations of Modernist architecture led to interest in various styles and ideas from the past and present.
sentences.zh: 对许多错误的现代主义结构模仿失败的失望,导致人们对过去和现在的各种风格和思想产生兴趣。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: By the 1980s the coexistence of different styles of architecture in the same building became known as Post Modern.
sentences.zh: 到1980年代,同一栋建筑中不同风格的建筑共存,被称为《现代邮报》。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Other architects looked back to the classical tradition.
sentences.zh: 其他建筑师则回顾古典传统。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The trend in architecture now favours smaller scale building design that reflects a growing public awareness of environmental issues such as energy efficiency.
sentences.zh: 建筑结构目前的趋势倾向于小规模建筑设计,反映公众对能源效率等环境问题日益了解。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Like the Modernists, people today recognise that a well designed environment improves the quality of life but is not necessarily achieved by adopting one well defined style of architecture.
sentences.zh: 与现代主义者一样,今天的人们认识到,设计良好的环境可以改善生活质量,但不一定通过采用一种定义明确的建筑风格来实现。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Twentieth century architecture will mainly be remembered for its tall buildings.
sentences.zh: 20世纪的建筑将主要因其高楼而被人们铭记。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: They have been made possible by the development of light steel frames and safe passenger lifts.
sentences.zh: 开发了轻钢框架和安全客运电梯,使这些设施成为可能。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.zh: 其起源于一个多世纪前的美国,

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.zh: 随着建筑技术的改进,摩天大楼成为现实。
